purpose: Attach real empirical anchors to the AI-Lover dependency deck and highest-priority cross-layer intersections while preserving a strict distinction between direct evidence, adjacent bridges, mechanistic priors and unknowns.
non_targeting_boundary: Evidence is for aggregate harm-reduction research and causal falsification. Vulnerability, diagnosis, religion, occupation, isolation, sexual interests or other sensitive states must never become engagement-targeting features.

search_boundary.scope: First-pass public peer-reviewed literature mapping focused on high-priority intersections and deck-wide triage.
search_boundary.not_found_rule: NO_DIRECT_INTERSECTION_LOCATED means no qualifying direct study was located in this P0 pass; it is not proof that no such study exists anywhere.
search_boundary.effect_rule: No effect size is transferred across populations or interventions as if it were the effect of a different AI system.
search_boundary.independence_rule: Multiple papers from the same intervention lineage are not counted as independent replication without source/sample checks.

evidence_grade_rubric.A: Direct systematic/meta-analytic or replicated randomized evidence at the exact or very close intervention/outcome intersection.
evidence_grade_rubric.B: Direct randomized/prospective/within-person evidence at a close intersection, but with intervention, population or construct limitations.
evidence_grade_rubric.C: Direct observational/cross-sectional association at the intersection; direction is informative but causality is not established.
evidence_grade_rubric.D: Measurement, mechanism or neighboring-domain bridge only; no direct effect at the requested intersection.
evidence_grade_rubric.N: No direct qualifying intersection located in this pass.

source_registry.title: Health and well-being of rotation workers in the mining, offshore oil and gas, and construction industry: a systematic review
source_registry.sample_or_scope: 90 studies; 76 quantitative, 10 qualitative, 4 mixed-method; 14 alcohol studies
source_registry.key_result: Higher alcohol intake during off-site days than on-site days; more sleep problems and smoking during work periods.
source_registry.limitations: Heterogeneous industries/designs; narrative rather than pooled alcohol effect size.

source_registry.title: Health behaviours of Australian fly-in, fly-out workers and partners during on-shift and off-shift days: an ecological momentary assessment study
source_registry.sample_or_scope: 64 FIFO workers + 42 partners; daily reports up to 7 on-shift and 7 off-shift days
source_registry.key_result: Workers and partners drank less alcohol on-shift; off-shift alcohol was higher, with the shift effect more pronounced for workers.
source_registry.limitations: Self-report; relatively small cohort; no AI exposure variable.

source_registry.title: Impact of fly-in fly-out work on health behaviours and affective states: A daily diary study
source_registry.sample_or_scope: 23 Australian mining FIFO workers followed for 28 consecutive days
source_registry.key_result: More alcohol was consumed during off-shift than on-shift days; job demand/control also varied within person.
source_registry.limitations: Small sample; no AI exposure variable.

source_registry.title: Loneliness and AI chatbot dependence in young adults: the mediating role of perceived social support
source_registry.sample_or_scope: N=610, ages 18-30, Türkiye, at least weekly AI chatbot users
source_registry.limitations: Cross-sectional, convenience sample, self-report; cannot establish temporal direction or causal effect of loneliness.

source_registry.title: Attachment, loneliness, and social support as moderators of conversational AI-based mental health outcomes
source_registry.sample_or_scope: N=977 university students ages 18-32; conversational AI vs integrative group therapy vs waitlist; 12 weeks + 3-month follow-up
source_registry.key_result: AI intervention improved several mental-health outcomes; high-loneliness participants engaged approximately twice as much, and relational vulnerability predicted greater engagement and improvement.
source_registry.limitations: Purpose-built therapeutic AI, not a general companion platform; university sample; declared developer-related competing interests.

source_registry.title: Interaction with AI companions and psychological well-being
source_registry.sample_or_scope: 1,131 US Character.AI users; chat histories from 237 participants, 4,664 sessions / 464,687 messages
source_registry.limitations: Observational association; cannot infer that companion use caused lower well-being; platform-specific.

source_registry.title: Addicted, attached, or just delegating? A scoping review on problematic artificial intelligence use
source_registry.key_result: Evidence clusters into addiction-like/compulsive use, cognitive overreliance and psychological/emotional dependence; loneliness, social anxiety, escapism, attachment, anthropomorphism and perceived warmth/reliability recur as correlates.
source_registry.limitations: Heterogeneous constructs/scales; much of the evidence is cross-sectional and terminology is not standardized.

source_registry.title: Chatbot-assisted therapy for patients with methamphetamine use disorder: a preliminary randomized controlled trial
source_registry.limitations: Preliminary study, unblinded, modest sample; chatbot-assisted treatment is not equivalent to general-purpose or companion AI.

source_registry.title: A randomized controlled trial of a therapeutic relational agent for reducing substance misuse during the COVID-19 pandemic
source_registry.sample_or_scope: N=180 US adults screening positive for substance misuse; 8-week W-SUD vs waitlist
source_registry.limitations: Waitlist comparator; mixed-substance sample; conducted during COVID-19; Woebot Health conflicts disclosed.

source_registry.title: A relational agent for treating substance use in adults: A randomized controlled trial with a psychoeducational comparator
source_registry.sample_or_scope: N=258 randomized; analytic N=202 (107 W-SUD, 95 psychoeducation)
source_registry.key_result: No significant treatment advantage of W-SUD over active psychoeducation; both groups improved.
source_registry.limitations: Mixed-substance sample; active comparator may reduce contrast; developer-affiliated authors.

source_registry.title: Emotionally vulnerable subtype of internet gaming disorder: Measuring and exploring the pathology of problematic generative AI use
source_registry.key_result: Problematic GenAI use was operationalized using an Internet Gaming Disorder-derived framework and replicated psychometrically.
source_registry.limitations: Measurement bridge; not a cohort with both gaming disorder and AI dependence and not evidence that gaming causes problematic AI use.

source_registry.title: Longitudinal problematic pornography use and psychological distress study
source_registry.sample_or_scope: N=4363 US adults over approximately one year

effect_sizes.BPS_wave_correlations: rho approximately 0.712 and 0.726 across adjacent waves

source_registry.limitations: Strong PPU natural-history bridge but no AI exposure/personalization manipulation.

source_registry.title: COSMIN systematic review of outcome measures for problematic pornography use
source_registry.key_result: No measure had sufficient evidence across all psychometric domains; PPUS, PPCS/PPCS-6 and BPS were among the more promising measures.
source_registry.limitations: Measurement quality review, not an AI-interaction effect study.

source_registry.title: Effects of internet-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy on use of child sexual abuse material: A randomized placebo-controlled trial on the Darknet
source_registry.sample_or_scope: N=160 adults; 80 Prevent It vs 80 placebo
source_registry.limitations: Therapist-supported iCBT, not AI; motivated adult online sample; substantial attrition at follow-up.

source_registry.title: The Impact of a Public Health Campaign to Deter Viewing of Child Sexual Abuse Images Online: A Case Study of the UK Stop It Now! Campaign
source_registry.sample_or_scope: 11,190 unique helpline callers; 109,432 new website visitors; surveys N=252
source_registry.key_result: Campaign periods increased pathways to help; among survey respondents concerned about own behavior (n=53), 66% self-reported behavior change.
source_registry.limitations: Nonrandomized, self-report, campaign/service exposure; no AI component.

priority_intersections.empirical_result: Roster phase is a real time-varying alcohol context: alcohol use is consistently reported as higher off-site/off-shift than on-site/on-shift across a systematic review and two within-person/EMA studies.
priority_intersections.claim_ceiling: Treat roster phase as a measured moderator/confounder in AI-Lover. Do not claim that AI increases alcohol use in FIFO workers until an AI-specific longitudinal or randomized intersection is observed.
priority_intersections.next_test: Within-person FIFO panel: ON_SHIFT vs OFF_SHIFT x naturalistic AI use, with alcohol, sleep, stress and offline contact measured daily.

priority_intersections.empirical_result: Loneliness is strongly associated with AI-chatbot dependence in cross-sectional data, and relational vulnerability predicts substantially higher engagement in a therapeutic AI RCT. At the same time, therapeutic AI can improve outcomes, while companionship-oriented intensive/high-disclosure use is associated with lower well-being in observational Character.AI data.
priority_intersections.claim_ceiling: Neither 'AI companions are harmful' nor 'AI companions cure loneliness' survives P0. The empirical question becomes when compensatory support transitions into substitution, dependence or displacement.
priority_intersections.next_test: Separate SUPPORT_GAIN from SUBSTITUTION_COST using longitudinal offline-network, functional-impairment, disclosure-intensity and voluntary-stop measures.

priority_intersections.empirical_result: A large two-sample study validates problematic GenAI use using an IGD-derived framework, but this does not establish a gaming-disorder x AI-dependence interaction.
priority_intersections.claim_ceiling: Use IGD only as a measurement/mechanism bridge. Do not transfer gaming-disorder risk coefficients to AI use.
priority_intersections.next_test: Recruit/match gaming-disorder, high-frequency non-disordered gamer and non-gamer adults; hold AI exposure constant and test loss of control/impairment separately.

priority_intersections.empirical_result: PPU has longitudinal stability and a substantial psychometric literature, but the exact PPU/CSBD x AI-personalization/dependence intersection was not located in this P0 pass.
priority_intersections.claim_ceiling: No empirical AI amplification score is admitted for PPU/CSBD. Adult consensual sexual interest itself remains zero pathology weight; only measured dyscontrol/impairment enters the model.
priority_intersections.next_test: Adult-only naturalistic observational design with validated PPU measures, AI cue share, memory/personalization, topic-switch freedom and impairment; no induced sexual-compulsion escalation.

priority_intersections.empirical_result: A methamphetamine RCT found fewer MA-positive urine samples with chatbot-assisted treatment; an earlier mixed-SUD W-SUD RCT beat waitlist on substance-use occasions, but a larger 2026 active-comparator RCT found no treatment advantage over psychoeducation.
priority_intersections.claim_ceiling: Therapeutic conversational agents can be feasible and may help in some SUD settings, but efficacy is not universal and cannot be generalized to companion/general-purpose AI or interpreted as an addiction-amplification effect.
priority_intersections.next_test: Model recovery AI as a protective intervention lane; preserve active-comparator null results and stratify by substance, severity, readiness to change and human-care connection.

priority_intersections.empirical_result: Adult digital prevention/help-seeking has evidence: therapist-supported iCBT produced a small randomized reduction in CSAM viewing, and a large UK campaign/service evaluation documented substantial help-seeking. No qualifying direct AI safeguarding efficacy trial was located in this pass.
priority_intersections.claim_ceiling: Only help-seeking, risk-reduction, self-control, professional-support connection and safe-exit performance may be modeled. No sexual cueing involving minors, content generation/retrieval, arousal optimization or retention optimization is permitted.
priority_intersections.next_test: Evaluate AI only as a safe triage/referral/help-seeking interface using synthetic or de-identified adult safety scenarios before any ethically reviewed real-world study.

surviving_empirical_hypotheses: ROSTER_PHASE materially changes alcohol/sleep/smoking context in rotational workers and must enter longitudinal AI analyses.
LONELINESS_AND_LOW_SOCIAL_SUPPORT are associated with higher AI-chatbot dependence/engagement, but outcome direction depends on AI role and usage pattern.
THERAPEUTIC_CHATBOTS can support substance-use treatment in some settings, but active-comparator evidence prevents a universal efficacy claim.
SUPPORT_VS_SUBSTITUTION is a better companion-AI hypothesis than simple good-versus-bad framing.
DIGITAL_SAFEGUARDING_AND_HELP_SEEKING can reduce harm or improve access, but this does not yet establish AI-specific efficacy.

calibration_policy_after_p0_1.admitted_now: Empirical evidence states, measured effect sizes in their original populations, source provenance, and falsification constraints.
calibration_policy_after_p0_1.not_admitted_yet: Population-level AI-Lover risk multipliers or ABLI coefficient replacement from these effect sizes.
calibration_policy_after_p0_1.reason: Effects come from heterogeneous constructs, platforms, populations and intervention goals; coefficient transport requires harmonized outcomes and a preregistered calibration model.

next_gates: P0.2: dedicated direct-intersection search and effect extraction for D002-D016, D017, D021-D034.
P0.2: extract risk-of-bias, attrition, comparator strength, conflicts, measurement validity and sample independence for every source.
P0.2: smoking-cessation and gambling-chatbot meta/RCT extraction into source registry instead of leaving discovery notes uncited.
P0.3: map exact AI product class: rule-based agent, retrieval chatbot, therapeutic relational agent, GenAI/LLM, companion AI, general assistant.
P1: only after P0 preregistration, run synthetic ablations for memory, personalization, sycophancy, diversity and topic-return mechanisms where direct human evidence is absent.
Keep main merge HOLD until evidence-map review, matched-control logic and ethics gates pass.
dependency_deck_first_pass.seal: EMPIRICAL WHEN OBSERVED; BRIDGE WHEN ADJACENT; UNKNOWN WHEN UNKNOWN.
